packageRules.description: Merging to main here auto-deploys to production (own Gitea CI -> registry -> Watchtower) - a bigger blast radius than the personal sites this shared config was designed for, so every bump stays a manual review-and-merge, security-flagged or not. A top-level automerge:false alone does NOT override the shared preset's more specific devDependencies/vulnerabilityAlerts packageRules (later-matching rules win per-field, and a bare default isn't one) - this catch-all rule (no match conditions = matches everything) is appended after the extended preset's own rules, so it wins instead.
